name: @local/dsh-katex-toolkit
description: One DSH client bundle for KaTeX chat math: clean LaTeX copy and a bounded render cache.

scripts.check: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check scripts/verify.mjs && node --check tests/toolkit.test.mjs && node scripts/verify.mjs

meta.title: KaTeX Toolkit
meta.description: Copying a selection that contains a formula yields ONE clean LaTeX source instead of KaTeX's two serialised DOM arms, and repeated renders of the same formula reuse the cached HTML.
